name: cat0_cube_complex

phase_0.boundary_condition: The entire chain complex forms a closed algebraic system bounded by the zero object and terminal homology groups.

VINIT.justification: Initial state before any simplices or boundary maps are defined.

TANCH.justification: Closed system containing all simplices, boundary operators, and satisfying d∘d=0.

AFWD.justification: Forward morphism reducing dimension: maps n-simplex to (n-1)-chain.

AREV.justification: Reverse morphism increasing dimension: adjoint to ∂ in cochain complexes.

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining of boundary operators resulting in zero.

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-reference: the complex recognizes its own algebraic structure.

FSPLIT.justification: Splits chain complex into even-degree and odd-degree subgroups.

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes original complex by combining even and odd degree parts.

ENGAGR.justification: Paradice: chain simultaneously in ker(∂) and im(∂).

IFIX.justification: Permanent record: quotient ker(∂)/im(∂) at fixed dimension.

phase_3.void_description: Empty chain complex with no simplices or boundary maps.
phase_3.true_description: Non-trivial cycle: element in ker(∂) not in im(∂).
phase_3.both_description: Trivial cycle: element in ker(∂) ∩ im(∂).

steps.domain_action: decompose C into C_even (0-chains) and C_odd (1-chains).
apply ∂ to e₁ in C_odd (yields v₁-v₀).
combine C_even and C_odd via ⊕ to recover C.
element v₁-v₀ is both cycle (∂=0) and boundary (from e₁).

phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Boundary maps transmitting data between dimensions.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Abelian groups storing chains at each dimension.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Dimension-wise processing: higher to lower for ∂, lower to higher for δ.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Algebraic operations (addition, scalar multiplication) and boundary computations.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Complex with simplex added and ∂ defined.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Homology groups are conservative invariants; quotient operations preserve information modulo identities.
